Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of the transaction expressed in the currency of the terminal or as a reversed amount of a previous authorisation.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency code associated with the transaction amount.  ISO 4217 "Codes for the representation of currencies and funds"

CardholderBillingAmount.name: Cardholder Billing Amount
CardholderBillingAmount.definition: Amount of the transaction in cardholder billing currency.

CardholderBillingCurrency.name: Cardholder Billing Currency
CardholderBillingCurrency.definition: Currency code of Cardholder and associated with cardholder billing amount.  ISO 4217 "Codes for the representation of currencies and funds".

CardholderBillingEffectiveExchangeRate.name: Cardholder Billing Effective Exchange Rate
CardholderBillingEffectiveExchangeRate.definition: Effective exchange rate used in the conversion from transaction amount to cardholder billing amount.

ReconciliationAmount.name: Reconciliation Amount
ReconciliationAmount.definition: Amount of the transaction in Reconciliation currency

ReconciliationCurrency.name: Reconciliation Currency
ReconciliationCurrency.definition: Currency code of Reconciliation and associated with Reconciliation amount.  ISO 4217 "Codes for the representation of currencies and funds".

ReconciliationEffectiveExchangeRate.name: Reconciliation Effective Exchange Rate
ReconciliationEffectiveExchangeRate.definition: Effective exchange rate used in the conversion from transaction amount to reconciliation amount.

DetailedAmount.name: Detailed Amount
DetailedAmount.definition: Further details of some or all amounts in the transaction amount.
